messages:
Jules (sales): quick sync on the Acme POC — can we align on acceptance criteria + model choices?
Alex N.: yes — main asks from customer: 1) summarize long policy docs (32k context) 2) answer retrieval-augmented Q&A with citations 3) low-latency snippet reranking for UI
Maria G.: timeline they want is 4 weeks for a trial with 2 integrations (web + support).
Suresh R.: key infra constraints: customer needs on-prem option, HSM for keys, and strict data retention (30d). Also latency SLO: 200ms p50 for short Qs.
Eva M.: for summarization we should test a 32k-context model variant. Two options: open 32k quantized or split-to-chunk + embeddings + reranker. Tradeoffs: native 32k keeps coherence but costs more.
Jules (sales): pricing sensitivity? they asked about Hosted vs Dedicated cost for 32k workload.
Alex N.: rough numbers: Hosted (approx): $0.10 / 1k tokens for long-context generation; Dedicated: committed infra reduces unit cost ~30–50% depending on usage. Need exact ask from sales for quote.
Maria G.: also security questionnaire outstanding: they want SOC2 + support for KMS/HSM, network egress controls. I've attached the doc in the deal binder.
Suresh R.: operational blocker: tool-calling allowed? They want to run internal retrieval endpoints and allow model to call an internal search tool. We need to confirm private deployment supports tool calling to internal endpoints without internet egress.
Eva M.: confirmation: Redwood Private supports private tool endpoints inside VPC and can be configured for no egress. We'll document the network architecture.
Jules (sales): ok next: success criteria for the POC. Suggested acceptance list:
- Accuracy: F1-style metric on QA set >= 0.78 (eval set they provided)
- Latency: p50 < 200ms for single-turn Q, p95 < 800ms for long-context summarization
- Rerank lift: NDCG@10 improvement > 15% vs baseline
- Security: private deployment + KMS integration + completed sec questionnaire
- Integration: web plugin demo + automated eval harness running nightly
Alex N.: sounds good. Need to add prompt-level evals: a small set of 30 prompts representing edge cases. We'll produce a prompt bank and baseline outputs.
Maria G.: client asked if embeddings-only approach is acceptable for Q&A (dense retrieval + rerank) vs tool-calling. They are worried about hallucinations.
Suresh R.: recommendation: dense retrieve + reranker + conservative answer filter. Use embeddings for candidate retrieval (FAISS), then a reranker model (smaller cross-encoder) to boost precision before generation. This reduces hallucination risk and cost.
Eva M.: propose evaluation plan: week 0-1: dataset ingest + embedding index; week 2: reranker tuning + small A/B; week 3: end-to-end QA latency tuning; week 4: demo + final metrics.
Jules (sales): can you sketch the models to try? they asked about tool calling for structured extraction too.
Alex N.: model matrix:
- Candidate A: 32k-context LLM (quantized) for single-pass summarization and tool-calls
- Candidate B: 8k-context LLM + retrieve+rerank pipeline for Q&A and reranked snippets
- Reranker: cross-encoder (small) for NDCG improvements
- Extractor: specialized extractor prompt + function-calling hook to downstream service

Suresh R.: for tool-calling we'll test function/schema calling with strict validation and deny-listing. We'll supply a schema example:
```json
{"function":"extract_policy_fields","args_schema":{"policy_id":"string","effective_date":"string","summary":"string"}}
```

Eva M.: evaluation metrics to capture in Console: token cost, per-route latency, NDCG, exact-match for extractions, and hallucination rate (manual review sample).
Jules (sales): any red flags before we commit?
Maria G.: legal asked about data residency for EU users — need EU region private deployment. Also need a clause about metric data retention.
Suresh R.: implementation risk: if they insist on on-prem air-gapped, timeline jumps ~2–3 weeks for infra prep and VPN/networking. Call that out in SOW.
Alex N.: action items: 1) provide a short quote range for Hosted vs Dedicated for expected token volumes (sales) 2) engineering to produce prompt bank + eval harness (Alex/Eva) 3) security to answer sec questionnaire and confirm KMS/HSM setup (Maria/Suresh) 4) draft SOW with timeline and optional on-prem addon (Jules)
Jules (sales): I'll send the quote and SOW draft by EOD tomorrow. Can engineering lock in availability for week 0 kickoff?
Alex N.: yes — we'll reserve a slot.
POC Bot: Reminder: created POC workspace and pushed initial evaluation repo: https://git.redwood/poc/acme.
Eva M.: adding final note — recommend trying reranker first for immediate gains; reserve 32k-run only for the summarization acceptance tests to save cost.
Jules (sales): perfect. i'll sync with the customer and update this thread with any scope changes. :thumbsup:
